query:
SELECT EXISTS(
            SELECT 1
            FROM chat_turns c
            JOIN room_messages m ON m.id=c.room_message_id
            JOIN tasks t ON t.room_id=m.room_id
            JOIN human_accounts a ON a.id=$1
            WHERE c.id=$2 AND t.created_by<>a.id AND a.role<>'administrator'
        ) AS "refused!"
